notesI18n.zh: 排队任务不再受费用保护二次暂定：任务一旦进入队列就直接执行，不会因为在队列中等待期间 token 涨过阈值而停下等待确认。费用提示仍保留在发送前。
notesI18n.en: Queued tasks now always run: once accepted into the queue a task no longer waits for cost confirmation when token usage crosses the threshold while it is queued. The cost prompt still appears before sending.
